question: Can StrokeEvent identity be made stable across paddle-representation changes (the measured rally1 merge cascade and the 0%-overlap cascade loss), without losing event quality?
change: stroke-event-2: TARGET body (wrist) motion PROPOSES events (fragment glue ≤350ms + two-threshold boundary relaxation ≥max(12% peak, 0.08)); paddle evidence only CONFIRMS/RANKS (decisive peak inside ⇒ paddleConfirmed, +confidence, peak refined ≤250ms) and breaks prominence ties; paddle-only proposals exist solely as a FLAGGED fallback when body evidence is absent. CONTACT SCOPE decoupled from event bounds (peak ±450ms clamp) after the widened windows tripped the disagreement gate. Unit-tested contract: paddle content cannot create, delete, or re-bound a proposal.

before_v1.targetRecall: 4/5 (proposal-level; SELECTED window for rally1 had 0% gold overlap)

results_merge_safety.protocol: same dev videos with --merge-tracklets, isolated out-dirs
results_merge_safety.volley: IDENTICAL event set and selection; contact 43→49ms — SAFE
results_merge_safety.rally1: event proposals BYTE-IDENTICAL under merge (the v1 failure class is dead); but merged other-player paddle fragments + an opponent-side ball direction change fabricate a 'ball+paddle confirmed' contact at 546ms inside the ready-hop event → selection flips via the CONTACT channel (gold contact 2900).
results_merge_safety.conclusion: Decoupling holds at the proposal layer. Merge promotion remains blocked on (a) target-conditioned tracklet reconciliation and (b) target-gated contact evidence (ball/paddle proximity must be to the TARGET's paddle/wrist).

results_cascade_n5.vs_previous: end-to-end survival unchanged at 1/5, but the loss distribution moved from EVENT-identity errors to CONTACT abstentions: vic event overlap 36%→88% (contact-inside), rally1 is now honestly MULTI_STROKE_AMBIGUOUS instead of confidently analyzing a 0%-overlap window (its wrong stroke prediction is gone), dink event 40%→42% but slid past the 50% gate with contact abstained.
results_cascade_n5.newDominantLoss: CONTACT: compact strokes (dink) peak wrist speed AFTER contact and the multi-signal disagreement gate abstains (dink 307ms, vic 380ms disagreement). Contact fusion — not event identity — is now the cascade's binding constraint.

The second evaluation is recorded here rather than hidden; no thresholds were tuned against held-out outputs between runs (the contact-scope fix was motivated and verified on dev cases).
